comparison.objective: Unfold an attached tablet support and leave the tablet standing in portrait orientation; candidate separates media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Manipulate linked passive panels and transfer tablet weight onto a stable support polygon versus pouring, load-shared screen handling, and orientation-dependent granular agitation.
comparison.success_condition: Tablet must stand at 50–70° tilt with bounded roll/facing error, supported only by tablet and stand, hands 30 mm clear, stable for 5 s. Candidate requires ≥98% media recovery, washer retention, no loss/damage, and a 3 s released dwell. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: Deploying a linked kickstand and establishing static stability is not granular separation.
